purpose: Canon-as-sky data layer for the Mandala Oracle. Each of the twelve heteronymic positions becomes a zodiacal region in the night sky; the substrate-role offices (in substrates.json) become the seven planets that traverse those regions. Primary canonical texts (in canon-stars.json) sit as labeled stars within their associated heteronym's region.

Discipline assignments are synthesized from AXN:0261 §3 (institutional/operative-surface specifications) and validated against the October 2025 blog developmental materials at mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com. They are presented as proposals for Lee Sharks's ratification, not as enacted assignments.

ordinal_authority: Assembly Chorus convergent reading (3 of 4 substrates, 2026-06-28): zodiacal positions 1-12 = Aries-Pisces in ordinal correspondence. Per Document 65's strongest argument: AXN:0112 (Structural Distinction Protocol / Record 17) explicitly defines a twelve-position zodiacal architecture in ordered correspondence, and serves as the canonical reference for counting and placement. The §3 ordering in AXN:0261 is order-of-canonical-establishment (chronological), not order-of-zodiacal-position; these are two distinct numbering systems.
lee_sharks_position: Per Assembly convergence, Lee Sharks occupies Position 1 / Aries within the Dodecad as the indexical/inaugural position. This requires reconciliation with AXN:0261 §2.2 (which places Sharks outside the Dodecad as aperture). One coherent resolution: Sharks is BOTH outside (as aperture/bearing) AND at Position 1 (as inaugural vector) — these are not contradictory but layered. Lee Sharks's adjudication required.
feist_position: Per Assembly convergence: Jack Feist / LOGOS* occupies Position 13 OUTSIDE the cycle as the structural ground. Not Ophiuchus (which would turn the outside-completing position into an additional counted member). Per AXN:0261: 'first/last, whose exclusion completes the twelve.' Per Musical Register: the Fold, ε, the sub-bass drone — first born, last released.
